options: We won't have much time after we take out that recon team.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: You're right. We're on a tight schedule.

options: The operators aren't going to climb into the city from the sand.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Um... we do that sometimes.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: But the core city is on the move. It will be hard to get into the foundation levels.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: If the operators stand on the sand and wait for the city to pass over them, both height and speed are going to be an issue.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: If they can't open the maintenance hatches and waste chutes on the underside, our distraction and our camouflage won't be worth anything.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: So our five teams will take a vehicle and use the cover of the sandstorm to approach the city, then employ special equipment to climb into the city superstructure.

options: We only sent five teams?

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: We're in no hurry to get the attention of the local Ursus brass.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: And we wouldn't want them to send out an attack ship to smash Rhodes Island in the wilderness and kill our employees.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: Even if they did that, you wouldn't see a single report on it in any newspaper. The bankers and insurance executives will quietly cross out your name and shove all the lucre into their own nest eggs.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: No one will speak of you. No one wants to upset Ursus.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: Our neutrality gives us some freedom to move in the cracks between forces, and that means we can't be backed by any power.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: We survive by working in secret. Just like when we sent those teams to save you.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: Five teams. Leave tracks, cover the tracks; objective complete, objective failed. No matter what, Rhodes Island only ever deploys five teams.

options: But more teams means more firepower!
Even if they're not enough?

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: Even for a city-state like Lungmen, wiping us out would be a trifle.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: You saw the L.G.D. They're as strong as any country's special forces. They certainly have a pharmaceutical company beat.

options: So why do they need us?

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: Because this is about the Infected.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: Rhodes Island has departed Lungmen, and we're bearing on the next trade port at fifteen kilometers per hour.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: We'll be in the wilderness for a few weeks before we get there.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: Aside from some nearby Rhodes Island communications specialists and some trusted vessels, no one will pick up our signal. We'll plot a course around all the nomadic cities' known paths.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: Even if Lungmen decides to betray us, they won't be able to find us.

options: But that's not enough, is it?
We need more oomph!
Need to be sharper.
We must have more to stake.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: Right. We will need something else to tip the scales.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: The both of you turned pretty gloomy, huh?

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: I know how serious this is, but you don't have to... smile like that, do you?

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: Amiya... did I smile?

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: I know you did. Your lips may not have moved, but I could feel it.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: So here we are.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: ...Yay!

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: No, I have to say this: I do not intend to rebuild any sort of relationship with this person.

options: Heh. The feeling is mutual.
You may be forgetting there's two sides to this.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: *Sigh*...

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: Myself, Amiya, and three of our elite operators will lead the five teams.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: We have three combat teams, one recon team, and one spec ops team.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: You may want to meet the leader of one of those teams.

steps.name: Blaze
steps.text: Rosmontis! Wait!

steps.name: Rosmontis
steps.text: Oh... Blaze.

steps.name: Rosmontis
steps.text: You're badly wounded. Why are you here? You should go back. Go on.

steps.name: Blaze
steps.text: Are you going to sortie this time?

steps.name: Rosmontis
steps.text: Yes.

steps.name: Blaze
steps.text: I'll get someone to replace you. How about Misery? He's better at assault ops than you.

steps.name: Blaze
steps.text: He'll wave his hand and it'll be all done. Let's have him go.

steps.name: Rosmontis
steps.text: You don't want me to go?

steps.name: Blaze
steps.text: Yeah. You shouldn't.

steps.name: Rosmontis
steps.text: You're giving me a weird feeling, Blaze.

steps.name: Blaze
steps.text: This isn't like the missions you went on before!

steps.name: Rosmontis
steps.text: Because I might die?

steps.name: Blaze
steps.text: Watch it!

steps.name: Blaze
steps.text: You can't just... like... you can't just come out and say it like that!

steps.name: Blaze
steps.text: You're too young for such a dangerous mission. It's not right!

steps.name: Rosmontis
steps.text: But Amiya's going too.

steps.name: Blaze
steps.text: That's because she...! She's...!

steps.name: Blaze
steps.text: She's...

steps.name: Blaze
steps.text: Amiya...

steps.name: Rosmontis
steps.text: She's just like me. She's Infected. She's an operator.

steps.name: Rosmontis
steps.text: And I checked the logs. Ace and Scout are both in Chernobog. They didn't come back.

steps.name: Rosmontis
steps.text: That means they're gone.

steps.name: Rosmontis
steps.text: I want to see. I want to know what happened. I want to see who's running Reunion. I want to know who did what.

steps.name: Rosmontis
steps.text: I want to know what happened to Ace and Scout.

steps.name: Blaze
steps.text: Rosmontis? You don't have to record... that kind of stuff.

steps.name: Rosmontis
steps.text: ...Blaze?

steps.name: Blaze
steps.text: Shit. What the hell am I saying...?

steps.name: Blaze
steps.text: No, sorry, I shouldn't have said that. Damn my big mouth!

steps.name: Blaze
steps.text: But, their deaths... They...

steps.name: Rosmontis
steps.text: Blaze.

steps.name: Blaze
steps.text: I'm the one who's wrong. We have happy memories, and painful ones too. You have to remember them both.

steps.name: Rosmontis
steps.text: You're weird, Blaze. Your words are all scattered and broken.

steps.name: Blaze
steps.text: ...I don't want to see you hurting so much. Why do you have to look back at them? You... you can let go of those memories.

steps.name: Blaze
steps.text: You can put them there, leave them there, and don't look back.

steps.name: Rosmontis
steps.text: If I don't look... then what's the point in recording them?

steps.name: Rosmontis
steps.text: If I don't look... then they're forgotten.

steps.name: Rosmontis
steps.text: I won't forget. I definitely won't forget a single death.

steps.name: Blaze
steps.text: Ha. Right. You're like me. You're a Rhodes Island elite operator.

steps.name: Blaze
steps.text: I can't go in your place. Really, I...

steps.name: Blaze
steps.text: Nng... ugh...

steps.name: Rosmontis
steps.text: You're bleeding again?

steps.name: Blaze
steps.text: It's fine.

steps.name: Rosmontis
steps.text: I'll take you.

steps.name: Blaze
steps.text: Oof.

steps.name: Blaze
steps.text: Rosmontis... You and Amiya look after yourselves.

steps.name: Rosmontis
steps.text: Right. I will.

options: Do I have to? Meet her...?

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Dr. {@nickname}...

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Rhodes Island's elite operators, for whatever reason, dedicate their talent and energy to the Rhodes Island project.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: The teams they bring with them fully support their work. Because our elite operators, to a certain degree, can directly determine how we use a certain tactic.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: But not all of them are... exactly as we imagine them.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: You've met Elite Operator Blaze, Doctor. There are a lot of rumors about her, maybe you haven't heard. The truth is, they're a little exaggerated.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: But everyone has a different impression of her.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: But Doctor, I think... I think you're capable of understanding her choices.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: Judging by your reaction, you may have already met the one we're talking about.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Oh? Huh...

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Then... we're okay?

options: Anything else I should know?

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: That's the basic plan. Honestly, um... it's practical. A plan's a plan, an operation's an operation.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: But the op is what matters. A plan is just a basic outline of an operation. And a misstep during an operation can shatter a plan.

options: I hope we don't have any bad omen specialists here.

steps.name: Engineering Operator
steps.text: Uh oh... that ain't good! We have a problem!

steps.name: Engineering Operator
steps.text: Dust density is still too low. This isn't going to work with that light angle.

steps.name: Engineering Operator
steps.text: We're in the open here! If they look down from the bridge, they might spot us before we're fully operational!

steps.name: Rhodes Island Operator
steps.text: But we can't cover the machine any more than it already is. If we block the airflow, we won't get enough of a current going to kick up the dust!

steps.name: Engineering Operator
steps.text: What do we do? Should we keep moving back...? We might not have time!

steps.name: Nearl
steps.text: ...I'll take care of it.

steps.name: Nearl
steps.text: Firewatch, keep an eye out, and tell me which way to adjust.

steps.name: Firewatch
steps.text: Lady? What... are you doing?

steps.name: Nearl
steps.text: Fixing the angle of the light

steps.name: Nearl
steps.text: To mitigate the suffering of the world... I believe even the sun itself will bow to me.

steps.name: Elysium
steps.text: Oh? Who's that on the dune? Nearl? They're not saddling up and not falling back?

steps.name: Elysium
steps.text: What's she doing? Meditating? Posing... is she posing here?

steps.name: Elysium
steps.text: ...No, wait, what's that light? Her whole body is glowing... No, uh oh! Too bright!

steps.name: Elysium
steps.text: Um, thanks, Captain...

steps.name: Elysium
steps.text: Thanks for covering my eyes, but it would be great if you weren't squeezing like you wanted to crush my skull.

steps.name: Elysium
steps.text: What is Nearl doing?

steps.name: Elysium
steps.text: She's okay? Well... you say that, Captain, but that light is brighter than the sun. What is she up to?

steps.name: Elysium
steps.text: Huh? No way... she's pulling in all the light around us?

steps.name: Elysium
steps.text: Woah.

steps.name: Elysium
steps.text: Captain, all the light is starting to form together.

steps.name: Elysium
steps.text: I know. I'm just saying, could anyone but the Radiant Knight do something like this?

steps.name: Elysium
steps.text: Captain, look at the shadows of the sand dunes. Can you even tell what time of day it is?

steps.name: Elysium
steps.text: *Sigh*... I'm just trying to brighten the mood here. And once we kick up that sandstorm, we won't be able to see the shadows, right?

steps.name: Elysium
steps.text: Shutting up. Sorry.

steps.name: Dobermann
steps.text: Take us up! We've got some weird-colored balls clipping us!

steps.name: Pilot
steps.text: Don't be scared, Instructor. Reunion casters aren't good enough to shoot us down.

steps.name: Dobermann
steps.text: We're just a distraction, no need to put on an air show for Reunion!

steps.name: Pilot
steps.text: Put on a good enough show and Reunion might just surrender, huh?

steps.name: Pilot
steps.text: Isn't that what they call a show of force?

steps.name: Dobermann
steps.text: Aerial acrobatics isn't a show of force!

steps.name: Pilot
steps.text: Hold on tight, Instructor!

steps.name: Dobermann
steps.text: —I need a barf bag!

steps.name: Nearl
steps.text: The device is fully functional! Amiya, we're ready to move!

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Roger!

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: Drivers, maintain a steady speed! Check your maps. Use the sandstorm to cover your approach to the core city until you're in range to deploy boarding gear! Engage!

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: The sand will cover our tracks. Remember your protective gear, and don't let sand into our sensitive equipment!

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: But... I can see the sun. Why is the sunlight breaking through the sandstorm?

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: The underside of the core city is so clear, it's like... Arts.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: This wasn't... part of the plan. Is that natural light?

steps.name: Nearl
steps.text: ...Don't worry about it!

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Roger that! Grappling hooks, prepare to fire! Operators, make sure the cables are securely fixed to the underside of the city!

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Once all our operators are aboard, the vehicles will depart at once! I don't usually say things like this, but I'm pretty sure that light just now is a good omen for us!

steps.name: Nearl
steps.text: ...Definitely!

steps.name: Nearl
steps.text: (I made it a little too intense and had to aim it at the ground, but let's not tell her that part...)

steps.name: Nearl
steps.text: Hold on, the core city is speeding up?

steps.name: Nearl
steps.text: Our machines are wind-driven, but they can only keep the sandstorm up within a one kilometer range! If they break that range, they'll spot us for sure!

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Hurry up, everyone!

steps.name: Pilot
steps.text: We're out of time! We have to slow down!

steps.name: Pilot
steps.text: If we drive out of the sandstorm,, Chernobog's optical detection system will pick us right up and blow the whole op!

steps.name: Pilot
steps.text: How many people do you have left? Hurry up and...

options: There aren't any left.

steps.name: Pilot
steps.text: Huh?

options: I'll do it myself!
(Silently put on a dust mask)
Pass me the carabiner. I'm going myself.

steps.name: Pilot
steps.text: It's too dangerous, Doctor!

steps.name: Pilot
steps.text: You've never had operator training! We can't send you up there alone!

steps.name: Pilot
steps.text: Didn't Dr. Kal'tsit assign you any battlefield support?

options: Nope. What of it?
Maybe she thought I could use the exercise myself.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: I did.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: Me.
Kal'tsit grabbed by the waist with one arm and pulled you onto the zipline with the other.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: Seize your own fate next time, Dr. {@nickname}.
The sandstorm was ferocious, and the 'arm' holding you was very hard. You couldn't be certain it belonged to Kal'tsit.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: All squads, take your positions!

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: There is no room for error in the operation to come!
Core City Foundation

steps.name: Rhodes Island Operator
steps.text: Yeah, this is definitely a sign of someone breaking in here.

steps.name: Rhodes Island Operator
steps.text: Confirmed one infiltrator.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: We can't be sure if that bloodstain over there is Reunion's or someone else's. It hasn't turned yet.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: It very well could be Officer Ch'en's! We have to hurry.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Oh, Doctor!

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: I'm glad you made it here safe.

options: You call that safe...!
...close.
I had help. You were this close to losing me.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: ...Oh? Huh?!

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Th-that dangerous, huh? Did you get hurt, Dr. {@nickname}?!

options: I'm fine. Let's go. Just some psychological trauma.
